description: This file implements a GStreamer source element class 'GstRialtoSrc' for the Rialto media framework, including methods for handling URI setting, message processing, state changes, and setup of media pipelines with optional DRM and payloader components.

classes.name: GstRialtoSrc
classes.description: A custom GStreamer source element class for Rialto, handling media streaming, URI management, and message processing.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcHandleMessage
methods.description: Handles messages such as EOS from the source element, forwarding EOS events when all appsrc pads are EOS.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcChangeState
methods.description: Manages state transitions, initiating async start/stop procedures during state changes.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcUriGetType
methods.description: Returns the URI type for the source element, which is 'GST_URI_SRC'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetProtocols
methods.description: Returns the supported URI protocols, in this case 'rialto'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetUri
methods.description: Retrieves the current URI set for the source element.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcSetUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the source element, only allowed in states below PAUSED.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcInit
methods.description: Initializes the source element, setting default properties.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcDispose
methods.description: Disposes of the source element, calling parent class dispose.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the source element, freeing resources.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcSetProperty
methods.description: Sets properties on the source element, delegating to parent class.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetProperty
methods.description: Gets properties from the source element, delegating to parent class.
